description: Find which US product-safety rules a consumer product must meet and which certificate the importer files: CPC (Children's Product Certificate, for products made for children 12 and under) or GCC (General Certificate of Conformity). Pass product as plain words, or describe what a photo shows. Add age and features (paint, small parts, batteries, magnets, metal parts) when known. Covers the 16 most common children's product types and 3 general ones. Returns each rule with its 16 CFR citation, whether a CPSC-accepted lab must test it, and the eFiling citation code. Use testedRuleIds with find_accepted_labs. It does not decide that a product is legal to sell.

age.description: The age the product is for, such as "6 to 18 months", "3+" or "adult"

features.description: Features that add rules, when the user said or the photo shows them

product.description: What the product is, who it is for and what it is made of, such as "painted wooden stacking toy for toddlers" or the visible facts in a product photo
